messages:
ajay: Heads up — we saw ~20% spike in preemptions in us-west-2 overnight, several jobs restarted mid-request. Thinking we need a tighter on-demand floor + smarter burst pool to avoid tail latencies.
kevin: agree. My quick thought: keep a regional on-demand floor (15% of total GPU capacity) + a warm burst pool of ~150 GPUs per busy region. warm pool = slower to scale cold, but avoids 503s on preempt.
sara: can we make the floor dynamic instead of static? like floor = max( min(0.2, prev24h_preempt_rate * 1.5), 0.05 ) so low-traffic regions stay cheap. Also guardrail to not exceed budget delta. :thinking: 
maria: +1 for dynamic floor. Also consider fast fallback routing: when preemption rate crosses threshold, route latency-sensitive traffic to smaller model variants or lower max_tokens to reduce tail tokens. We should define per-route fallback policies in the routing layer.
kevin: example fallback flow: primary = p4-32 + model v2, fallback = p3-8 + quantized v2-small, then cpu fallback for very low priority batch jobs. This reduces SLA hits but keeps throughput.
ajay: ops concerns: draining preempted nodes gracefully is still messy, we lost some KV cache state. Need drain hooks to push mem snapshot to redis before preempt. Also need a quick drain command for ops:
```
# drain node safely
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
# run cache flush hook
curl -X POST https://ops-api/flush-cache?node=<node>
```
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaleDown event at 2026-06-12T03:41:00Z, reason=preempt_replace, removed=8 gpus in us-west-2.
kevin: networking note — some customers hit ephemeral IP exhaustion when we spin up many small instances in the burst pool. Need to either consolidate into fewer larger instances or pre-allocate ENIs. Region specific: eu-west-1 has stricter ENI limits so floor should bias on-demand more there.
sara: cost tradeoffs: current spot discount avg ~65% but preemption variance causes 10-15% higher total cost from retries and fallback. We should model headroom cost vs retry cost: headroom = on-demand_floor * instance_hour_cost; retry_cost = preempt_rate * wasted_work_value. I'll run numbers.
maria: ops runbook TODOs: (1) implement dynamic-floor algo + feature flag, (2) add per-region ENI guardrail, (3) add cache-dump hook to node preempt lifecycle, (4) define routing fallback table for latency-critical routes.
ajay: agree. Quick terraform hint for weighted pools (draft):
```
resource "redwood_pool" "mixed" {
  region = "us-west-2"
  on_demand_percent = var.on_demand_floor
  spot_pools = ["c5g-large","p3-8"]
  warm_burst_size = 150
}
```
kevin: action: I'll prototype dynamic-floor and simulate 30-day preemption traces. sara, can you model cost delta if we keep 12% vs 18% floor?
sara: on it. I'll post sims in this thread tomorrow.
maria: I'll own the runbook and add the drain hook. ops-bot remind me in 24h to start the PR. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder set for maria in 24h.
ajay: thanks team — goal: reduce tail SLA incidents by 80% without >10% cost increase. We'll review sims and roll a feature-flagged canary in staging next week.
